sessionArchiveRepair.description: Publish deleted-session transcript archives that the host cannot publish because hard links are unavailable (Android/Termux). Unset = automatic (only when a probe shows hard links are broken); true = always; false = never.

blockSecretLeaks.description: Refuse to send a Zulip message that contains a credential value from the host config, so an agent cannot paste secrets into chat. Default: enabled.

activityTrace.description: Post one dedicated bot-owned status message per work item and edit it in place as the agent works, so the topic shows progress instead of only the final reply. Status detail edits the trace; actionable results stay separate messages. Default: disabled.

traceCoalesceMs.description: Bursty trace updates inside this window (ms) collapse into a single message edit. Clamped to 0-60000. Default: 400.

traceMaxRate.description: Hard ceiling on trace edits per second, in addition to the coalescing window. Clamped to 0.1-50. Default: 2.

historyContext.description: Harvest bounded past stream/topic history into the agent's context so it can answer 'have we seen this before?' with real evidence. off (default), on-demand (only for such questions), or always. Each harvest costs one Zulip round-trip and context budget.

historyMaxMessages.description: Maximum number of earlier messages injected as history context. Clamped to 1-50. Default: 8.

historyWindowHours.description: Only messages newer than this are considered for history context. Clamped to 1-8760. Default: 72.

historyMaxChars.description: Hard cap on the rendered history block in characters. Clamped to 200-20000. Default: 4000.

uiHints.label: Zulip
uiHints.description: Zulip channel provider configuration for bot auth, DM/group access policy, stream monitoring, and reply behavior.

apiKey.label: Zulip API Key
apiKey.description: Bot API key used to authenticate Zulip API requests for this account. Keep it secret and rotate it if exposed.

email.label: Zulip Bot Email
email.description: Bot email address shown under Active bots in Zulip.

url.label: Zulip Base URL
url.description: Base URL for the Zulip server, for example https://chat.example.com.

site.label: Zulip Site URL
site.description: Alias for the Zulip base URL.

realm.label: Zulip Realm URL
realm.description: Alias for the Zulip base URL / realm.

allowInsecureHttp.label: Allow Insecure HTTP (trusted network only)
allowInsecureHttp.description: Allow a plain http:// Zulip server and private/internal host addresses. Credentials are sent unencrypted; leave off unless you control the network.

sessionArchiveRepair.label: Session Archive Repair (hard-link workaround)
sessionArchiveRepair.description: Publish deleted-session transcript archives that the host cannot publish because hard links are unavailable (Android/Termux). Unset = automatic (only when a probe shows hard links are broken); true = always; false = never.

blockSecretLeaks.label: Block Credential Leaks (recommended)
blockSecretLeaks.description: Refuse to send a Zulip message that contains a credential value from the host config, so an agent cannot paste secrets into chat. Default: enabled.

activityTrace.label: Activity trace (progressive status message)
activityTrace.description: Post one dedicated bot-owned status message per work item and edit it in place as the agent works, so the topic shows progress instead of only the final reply. Status detail edits the trace; actionable results stay separate messages. Adds outbound writes (~600ms per Zulip edit). Default: disabled.

traceCoalesceMs.label: Trace coalescing window (ms)
traceCoalesceMs.description: Bursty trace updates inside this window collapse into a single message edit. Zulip edits are ~600ms round-trips. Clamped to 0-60000. Default: 400.

traceMaxRate.label: Trace max edits per second
traceMaxRate.description: Hard ceiling on trace edits per second, in addition to the coalescing window, so no configuration can flood the Zulip API. Clamped to 0.1-50. Default: 2.

historyContext.label: History-aware context
historyContext.description: Harvest bounded past stream/topic history into the agent's context so it can answer 'have we seen this before?' with real evidence. off (default), on-demand (only when the message looks like such a question), or always. Each harvest costs one Zulip round-trip and context budget.

historyMaxMessages.label: History max messages
historyMaxMessages.description: Maximum number of earlier messages injected as history context. Clamped to 1-50. Default: 8.

historyWindowHours.label: History window (hours)
historyWindowHours.description: Only messages newer than this are considered for history context. Clamped to 1-8760. Default: 72.

historyMaxChars.label: History max characters
historyMaxChars.description: Hard cap on the rendered history block, in characters, so a busy topic cannot blow up the context window. Clamped to 200-20000. Default: 4000.

renderRefs.label: Actionable refs (validated links)
renderRefs.description: Let the agent emit [[zulip_ref: <github url> | <label>]] markers; the plugin validates each ref against the GitHub API and renders it as a clickable link. Unconfirmed refs render as plain text and the reply still sends. Validation is unauthenticated (public refs only, GitHub's 60 req/hour/IP limit) and sends no credentials. Default: disabled.

streams.label: Zulip Streams
streams.description: Optional list of stream names the bot should monitor. Use ["*"] or omit depending on your routing design.

chatmode.label: Zulip Chat Mode
chatmode.description: Controls when the bot responds in streams: oncall, onmessage, or onchar.

oncharPrefixes.label: Zulip On-Char Prefixes
oncharPrefixes.description: Prefix characters that trigger replies when chatmode is onchar.

requireMention.label: Zulip Require Mention
requireMention.description: Require an explicit mention before responding in streams/groups.

dmPolicy.label: Zulip DM Policy
dmPolicy.description: Direct message access control (pairing or allowlist recommended). open requires allowFrom to include *.

allowFrom.label: Zulip DM Allowlist
allowFrom.description: Allowed Zulip users for direct messages when using allowlist/open DM policies.

groupAllowFrom.label: Zulip Group Allowlist
groupAllowFrom.description: Allowed Zulip users for group/stream-triggered interactions when using allowlist-based group policy.

groupPolicy.label: Zulip Group Policy
groupPolicy.description: Controls who can trigger the bot in streams/groups (allowlist, open, or disabled).

configWrites.label: Zulip Config Writes
configWrites.description: Allow Zulip-originated config changes from supported commands/events.

responsePrefix.label: Zulip Response Prefix
responsePrefix.description: Optional prefix added before outbound Zulip responses.

blockStreaming.label: Block Streaming
blockStreaming.description: When true, replies are delivered as completed blocks. When false, plain text from the model streams through as it arrives — useful for models that don't reliably tool-call.

autoSendOnMissingTool.label: Auto-send on missing tool call
autoSendOnMissingTool.description: If the agent ends a run with assistant text but never invoked the messaging tool, deliver the text to the channel anyway. Default: true.

showThinkingPlaceholder.label: Show thinking placeholder
showThinkingPlaceholder.description: Post a "Thinking..." placeholder message while generating a response. Disabled by default because it adds one Zulip API round-trip; typing indicators are shown either way.

dmSessionTurnLimit.label: DM session turn limit
dmSessionTurnLimit.description: Maximum inbound conversation turns in a single Zulip DM session before starting a fresh session. Prevents one long/broken conversation from bloating context for all future replies. 0 disables rotation.

enableSessionRecovery.label: Enable session recovery
enableSessionRecovery.description: When enabled, the bot scans recent DMs on startup for messages interrupted by a gateway restart and re-dispatches them. Default: disabled (opt-in).

maxMessagesPerMinute.label: Max messages per minute
maxMessagesPerMinute.description: Maximum number of inbound messages per minute from a single sender. Prevents a single user from flooding the bot. 0 disables rate limiting. Default: 60.

maxMessageLength.label: Max message length
maxMessageLength.description: Maximum total length of a single outbound message in characters. Messages exceeding this limit are truncated before delivery. Prevents downstream plugins from failing on excessively long content. Default: 20000. Use 0 to disable.
